params.body:
## Why

Decided by Shane and Ilse on 2026-09-17 (V-4 thread, `klant:beslissingen#v-4`, `klant:beslissingen#lijsten-2026-09-17`).

When Car-Pass answers ISSUE/ERROR, the dealer only saw it in the dialog that opened while polling. Close it, or leave the page, and the row said "Vandaag al aangevraagd om HH:MM" with no way to see which issue it was or to reopen the correction; the dealer had to wait until tomorrow. And a vehicle that already has a Car-Pass (sold and returned, or a recall remark on the report) could only get a fresh registration by copying the vehicle and deleting the original.

## What changes for the dealer

**Own-stock row.** When today's last stored step is an unanswered ISSUE/ERROR, the row shows the chip **"Car-Pass meldt een probleem"** (amber, Car-Pass logo) instead of "Vandaag al aangevraagd om …". Clicking it reopens the same correction dialog as during polling: the Car-Pass description in the dealer's language, the two fields prefilled from the sheet, and for issue 131 the confirm-or-correct pair. Nothing goes to Car-Pass until the dealer confirms or sends the correction. The state is derived from `carpass_requests` in the one query the page already makes; an accepted correction clears it, a refused one does not, and it is gone the next day (R S3-8.6: a confirmation must happen the same day).

**Vehicle sheet, step Data.** For a vehicle that already has a Car-Pass: the button **"Nieuwe Car-Pass-registratie"**, walking the existing `carpassRequest` flow (same confirmation, same issue dialogs, one registration per vehicle per day with the existing refusal). Under it the **registration history** of that vehicle: date, time, result (geregistreerd / probleem gemeld / geweigerd / in aanvraag), newest first, with the pdf link on the newest report. Both the Livewire sheet and the classic sheet get the section (the classic one posts to the existing route and shows the answer as a notification).

All new strings in nl/fr/en/de.

## How

- `App\Support\CarpassIssue` (open issue per vehicle from the stored steps; `describe()` is the one reading of a Car-Pass issue answer, shared with `CarpassController::buildIssueResponse`), `App\Support\CarpassHistory` (the list on the sheet), `CarpassPending::forPage` returns the `issue` set from the same rows.
- The Car-Pass methods of `OwnStockList` moved unchanged into the trait `App\Livewire\Concerns\CarpassActions`, plus `reopenCarpassIssue()`; `VehicleForm` uses the same trait, so the `carpassChip` Alpine component drives both screens. `carpassChip` gained `reopen()` and an optional title; `carpassSheetClassic` is the fetch fallback for the classic sheet.
- Rules: R S3-3.7 (text brought up to date, the counting landed), new R S3-3.9 and R S3-7.6, R S3-7.1 (no longer copy-only), code references that moved; open point O-05 updated (half done: the copy-the-link half remains). `php bin/rules-sources`: Geen problemen.

## Tests

`CarpassIssueChipTest` (issue wins over today, accepted correction clears, refused correction keeps, yesterday/report closes, one query for the page, reopen dispatches the same events with the stored text in nl and fr, 131 pair, nothing open, four languages), `CarpassNewRegistrationTest` (button only with a Car-Pass, history order and single pdf link, the click walks the existing flow, once-per-day refusal on the sheet, classic section). Two existing tests moved to the new design (`CarpassOncePerDayTest`, `CarpassPollingAndPendingTest`). Guards green: Alpine, HandlerWiring, CompiledViews, StylesheetSyntax, Rules*, FrenchTranslations, OwnStockRowMarkup, VehicleFormSheetMarkup, OwnStockList.

Hot files touched: `resources/views/ownstock/_wagen_rij.blade.php`, `resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php`, `resources/css/refresh.css`, `resources/lang/*/ownstock.php` (allowed for this task).

No real Car-Pass calls anywhere (Http::fake).
params.title: Car-Pass: issue chip on the row and a new registration from the sheet
